articles.title: Congress Urged to Advance PBM Reform Legislation
articles.summary: A recent opinion piece highlights the urgent need for the incoming Congress to pass comprehensive pharmacy benefit manager reform. For self-funded employers and PBMs, federal legislative momentum continues to build around pricing transparency, rebate reform, and fiduciary standards. This ongoing regulatory pressure emphasizes the need for employer-focused, transparent PBM models.

articles.title: PBMs Face New Legal Pressures for Fee Structure Transparency
articles.summary: Recent legal and regulatory developments are increasing pressure on pharmacy benefit managers to disclose detailed fee structures. This trend is highly relevant to self-funded employers seeking greater clarity on PBM pricing models and potential hidden costs. Plan sponsors must prepare to evaluate these disclosed fee frameworks during upcoming contract renewals.
